title: Robert F. Orton
vital_facts: Born 1937 Reno, Nevada; raised in Panguitch, Utah
Baptized as a child; Aaronic Priesthood as a youth; Melchizedek Priesthood as a young man
Married Joy Eveline Dahlberg in the Salt Lake Temple, 1963; six children
Bishop, Stake Young Mens President, Counselor in Stake Presidency
President of the St. George Utah Temple 2007-2010)
accuracy_caveat: Community-compiled biographies from gapages.com (offline since 2023). Recovered from the Wayback Machine. Cross-reference with official Church sources.
